assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
Diagnosis code I48.91 is associated with the patient's condition.
Diagnosis code I47.1 is associated with the patient's condition.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management due to the intermittent nature of symptoms and need for continuous rhythm correlation.
